name: application-charts
title: Charts
description: Data visualization components — line, bar, donut, radar, scatter, bubble, and combo charts — for dashboard and analytics pages.
useWhen: Users need to understand trends, distributions, or comparisons in quantitative data.
An analytics or reporting dashboard requires embedded visual summaries of key metrics.
A stat card needs a compact sparkline to show directional movement over time.
avoidWhen: Precise values matter more than trends — use a data table instead.
The dataset has fewer than three data points — a stat with a delta label is clearer.
The chart cannot be made accessible to keyboard and screen-reader users in the deployment context.
responsiveBehavior: Chart canvases resize via Chart.js built-in handling. Constrain container widths and supply explicit heights so charts do not collapse on small viewports.
accessibility: Provide a text summary or data table alongside each chart for screen-reader users.
Do not rely solely on color to differentiate data series — use distinct line patterns or direct labels.
Tooltips must be keyboard-reachable and must not disappear on focus loss.

variants.title: Line chart with filled area and range toggle
variants.description: Filled-area line chart with period-range toggle buttons for showing revenue or traffic trends over selectable time windows.
accessibility: Range toggle buttons use aria-pressed to communicate the selected period to screen readers.

variants.title: Line chart with filled area and range toggle (Dark)
variants.description: Filled-area line chart with period-range toggle adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Dark chart grid lines and axis labels maintain readable contrast.

variants.title: Bar chart with tooltip
variants.description: Vertical bar chart for comparing discrete values across categories, with a hover tooltip showing exact figures.
accessibility: Tooltip values should also be available in an adjacent data table for keyboard users.

variants.title: Bar chart with tooltip (Dark)
variants.description: Vertical bar chart with hover tooltip adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Dark bar fill colors must be distinguishable from the background at all zoom levels.

variants.title: Donut chart with legend
variants.description: Proportional donut chart with a colour-coded legend for category breakdowns such as traffic sources or revenue split.
accessibility: Legend items pair color swatches with text labels so colorblind users can identify segments.

variants.title: Donut chart with legend (Dark)
variants.description: Proportional donut chart with colour-coded legend adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Legend text labels maintain readable contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Sparkline for stat cards
variants.description: Minimal inline sparkline designed to embed inside a stat card and convey directional trend without axis labels.
accessibility: The sparkline is decorative; the stat card's text value carries the accessible information.

variants.title: Sparkline for stat cards (Dark)
variants.description: Inline sparkline trend indicator adapted for dark stat card surfaces.
accessibility: The sparkline is decorative; the stat card's text value carries the accessible information.

variants.title: Stacked bar chart by category
variants.description: Stacked vertical bars showing both the total and the per-category breakdown within each bar.
accessibility: Segment colors must be distinguishable from each other without relying on hue alone.

variants.title: Stacked bar chart by category (Dark)
variants.description: Category-stacked bar chart adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Segment fill colors must remain distinguishable from each other on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Combo chart with bars and a target line
variants.description: Combined bar and line chart overlaying a performance target or benchmark line on top of bar series data.
accessibility: Legend must label both the bar series and the target line so users understand both data sets.

variants.title: Combo chart with bars and a target line (Dark)
variants.description: Bar-and-target-line combo chart adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Target line must contrast clearly with bars and the dark background.

variants.title: Line chart comparing two periods
variants.description: Dual-series line chart overlaying two time periods for year-over-year or month-over-month comparison.
accessibility: Two series should use distinct colors and line patterns to remain distinguishable without color.

variants.title: Line chart comparing two periods (Dark)
variants.description: Dual-series period-comparison line chart adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Both series lines must contrast with the dark background and with each other.

variants.title: Radar chart comparing two series
variants.description: Spider/radar chart for comparing two entities across multiple dimensions, such as skill profiles or product attributes.
accessibility: Radar axes should be labeled; provide a data table for screen-reader users who cannot interpret the shape.

variants.title: Radar chart comparing two series (Dark)
variants.description: Multi-dimension radar comparison chart adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Axis grid lines and labels maintain readable contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Polar area chart with legend
variants.description: Polar area chart where segment radius encodes magnitude, for comparing categories that share a common center.
accessibility: Legend text labels are required since segment size encodes data without numeric axis labels.

variants.title: Polar area chart with legend (Dark)
variants.description: Polar area chart with colour-coded legend adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Legend text labels must maintain readable contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Scatter chart with axis titles
variants.description: Two-axis scatter plot for visualizing correlation between two continuous variables, with explicit axis titles.
accessibility: Axis titles must be present; provide a summary of the correlation pattern in adjacent text.

variants.title: Scatter chart with axis titles (Dark)
variants.description: Labeled-axis scatter plot adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Axis titles and data point markers maintain readable contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Bubble chart with sized data points
variants.description: Three-variable bubble chart where X position, Y position, and bubble radius each encode a distinct data dimension.
accessibility: Bubble size encodes data; provide axis labels, a size scale legend, and a data table for screen readers.

variants.title: Bubble chart with sized data points (Dark)
variants.description: Three-variable bubble chart adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Bubble fill colors must contrast with the dark background so size differences remain visible.
